summary: A semiconductor selloff extended into Friday, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index tracking toward 20% declines from recent highs as investors rotated out of crowded AI hardware names amid growing uncertainty over AI economics. New AI model compression technology raised fears of a sooner-than-expected memory price collapse, hitting U.S. memory stocks hard — Micron on track for -10% and SandDisk -24% on the week.
tweet: Semis in freefall on AI valuation reset and oil-driven rate fears are dragging stocks lower, keeping the week's sentiment split between tech wreckage and resilient credit spreads.
